units: <cite ref="Shabbat 110a:6">Sabb. 110ᵃ</cite>, a. e. (explain. <he>מי דקרין</he>, v. <cite ref="D01009"><he>דֶּקֶל</he></cite>) <he>שהם דּוֹקְרִין וכ׳</he> because they make an opening in the bile.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 9:1:5">Y. Ned. IX, 41ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>ודוֹקְרָהּ בלבו</he> and sticks it (the sword) into his own heart.
Succ. 13ᵃ Ar.; Erub. 11ᵇ; 16ᵃ קנים הדּוֹקְרִים (הדּוֹקְרִין) reeds which spread, i.e. the top reeds, v. דּוֹקְרָן.—Part. Pu. מְדוּקָּר ramified, formed like a דּוֹקְרָן.

senses.gloss: to be pierced, stabbed. Tanḥ. Pinḥ. 1; Num. R. s. 21, beg.
